en: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.
SNORLAX woke up!\pIt attacked in a grumpy rage!
SNORLAX calmed down.\nIt gave a huge yawn…\lAnd returned to the mountains.
Want to use the POKé FLUTE?
{PLAYER} played the POKé FLUTE.
Yeah!\nI got a bite here!
Tch!\nJust a small fry…
Hang on!\nMy line's snagged!
Be patient.\nFishing is a waiting game.
That one got away!
With a better ROD, I could catch\nbetter POKéMON…
I'm searching for a MOON STONE.\nHave you found one?
Oww!
I could have made my POKéMON\nevolve with a MOON STONE.\pI would have won then, I bet.
Electricity is my specialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.
Unplugged!
Water conducts electricity, so you\nshould zap sea POKéMON.
The FISHING FOOL versus POKéMON\nKID!
Touch too much!
I guess you get to be good at\nwhat you like.\pWell, you beat me at POKéMON,\nbut you can't top me at fishing.
I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\pBut it'd be best if I also had more\nwork.
It's not easy…
It's all right.\nLosing doesn't bug me anymore.
What's catching?\pYou never know what you could\ncatch!
Lost it!
What, MAGIKARP?\pI catch them all the time, sure.\nBut, boy are they wimpy.
